about: Recorded results of 2026 award ceremonies, read from each organizer's own page (the owner's v6 package, 02-WORLD-AND-HISTORY.md E; November 13, 2026). The 83rd Golden Globe Awards and the 98th Academy Awards whole, every competitive category (from November 19, 2026; until then a small representative set): only what the cited page states is here, word for word, and a category a page doesn't state is absent, not guessed. Each observation is reportable from its publication date, never earlier. Names are kept as each source writes them.

coverage.notInSet: Every other 2026 ceremony and festival. The 37th PGA Awards from November 19, 2026: the 10 categories decided on February 28 whole, and the children's and short-form winners of February 26 (not their nominees). The 78th Writers Guild Awards from November 19, 2026: the 15 categories the game holds and the WGA's page lays out alike (not the variety, quiz, daytime, news, radio or promotional ones). The 78th DGA Awards from November 19, 2026: every category's nominees but Commercials, and every winner but Comedy Series, which the DGA's release doesn't state as a winner. The 32nd Actor Awards are recorded whole from November 19, 2026 (15 categories). The 2026 Emmys are recorded whole from November 19, 2026: all 120 categories' winners, and the nominees of the 117 whose page lists a field (three list only their winners: two juried awards and an area award). The 83rd Golden Globe Awards (from goldenglobes.com/nominations/2026) and the 98th Academy Awards are recorded whole from November 19, 2026; until then five Golden Globes were, and the night's article, which names The Pitt and The Studio as series winners without saying which won which, left both out (the nominations page says: The Pitt, Drama; The Studio, Musical or Comedy).
